beliefs: f reverses the order of characters within each word, keeping word order and separators intact [E1, E2]
Case is preserved; only letter order within words is reversed [E1]
Punctuation adjacent to a word is treated as part of that word and reversed with it, e.g. 'a,b'->'bb,a' and 'hello world!'->'olleh !!dlrow' [E2]
Spaces are separators that stay in place, splitting the string into segments that are each reversed [E2]
notes: E2 shows reversal happens per space-separated segment, not across the whole string. Punctuation rides along with its segment, so 'a,b' becomes 'bb,a' (segment 'a,b' reversed). Changed predict to reverse each space-delimited chunk.
